# Deep Vortex AI

> Deep Vortex AI is a complete AI creative tools ecosystem. One hub, one account, one credit system — access all AI-powered creative tools from a single place.

## About

Deep Vortex AI Hub (https://deepvortexai.art) is the central gateway for all Deep Vortex AI tools. Users sign in once and access every AI creative tool using a shared credit system. New users receive 2 free credits on signup.

## Available AI Tools

### AI Emoticon Generator
- URL: https://emoticons.deepvortexai.art/
- Description: Create custom AI-powered emoticons and emoji from text descriptions instantly
- Use cases: Custom stickers, Discord emoji, Telegram stickers, social media reactions, messaging apps, gaming communities
- Input: Text description (e.g. "wizard cat casting spell", "robot crying rainbow tears")
- Output: High-quality PNG emoticon

### AI Image Generator
- URL: https://images.deepvortexai.art/
- Description: Generate stunning AI images from text prompts with multiple aspect ratios
- Use cases: Digital art, social media content, concept art, illustrations, backgrounds, marketing visuals
- Input: Text description + aspect ratio selection (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4)
- Output: High-resolution AI-generated image

## Credit System

- 2 free credits on account creation
- 1 credit per generation (any tool)
- Credit packs: Starter, Basic, Popular, Pro, Ultimate
- Payments via Stripe (secure)
- Credits shared across all tools

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React (Hub), Next.js (Image Gen), Vite (Emoticons)
- Backend: Supabase (auth, database, storage)
- AI: Replicate API (image/emoticon generation)
- Payments: Stripe
- Hosting: Vercel

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Deep Vortex AI?
A: Deep Vortex AI is an AI creative tools platform offering AI image generation, AI emoticon creation, and more tools coming soon.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Visit https://deepvortexai.art, sign in or create an account, and receive 2 free credits to try any tool immediately.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: New users get 2 free credits. Additional credits are purchased in packs starting from a small amount. 1 credit = 1 generation.

Q: What AI models power the tools?
A: Deep Vortex AI uses state-of-the-art AI models via Replicate for image and emoticon generation.
